import requests

def get_uniprot_info(gene_name):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:{gene_name}+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true&fields=accession,id,gene_names,protein_name,mass,sequence"
    r = requests.get(url)
    data = r.json()
    for entry in data.get('results', []):
        acc = entry['primaryAccession']
        genes = [g.get('geneName', {}).get('value') for g in entry.get('genes', [])]
        mass = entry.get('sequence', {}).get('mass')
        length = entry.get('sequence', {}).get('length')
        print(f"Gene: {gene_name}, Accession: {acc}, Mass (Da): {mass}, Length: {length} aa")

print("Querying HORMAD1 and INPP5K:")
get_uniprot_info("HORMAD1")
get_uniprot_info("INPP5K")

import requests

def get_detailed_isoforms(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    r = requests.get(url)
    data = r.json()
    comments = data.get('comments', [])
    for c in comments:
        if c.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS':
            for iso in c.get('isoforms', []):
                print(f"Isoform: {iso.get('isoformIds')}, Name: {iso.get('name', {}).get('value')}")
    # Also check mass of canonical sequence
    seq_info = data.get('sequence', {})
    print(f"Canonical mass: {seq_info.get('mass')} Da, length: {seq_info.get('length')} aa")

print("HORMAD1 (Q86X24):")
get_detailed_isoforms("Q86X24")

print("\nINPP5K (Q9BT40):")
get_detailed_isoforms("Q9BT40")

import requests

def get_all_isoforms_mass(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=accession:{acc}&fields=accession,id,comments"
    # Or fetch fasta with includeIsoform=true
    fasta_url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta?includeIsoform=true"
    r = requests.get(fasta_url)
    lines = r.text.split(">")
    for block in lines:
        if not block.strip():
            continue
        header = block.split("\n")[0]
        seq = "".join(block.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
        # calculate approximate mass or exact mass
        # let's calculate mass using biopython or standard amino acid masses
        from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis
        pa = ProteinAnalysis(seq)
        print(f"Header: {header[:60]} | Length: {len(seq)} | Mass: {pa.molecular_weight():.2f} Da ({pa.molecular_weight()/1000:.2f} kDa)")

get_all_isoforms_mass("Q86X24")
get_all_isoforms_mass("Q9BT40")
